import html # Predefined template for a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = "
\n

{title}

\n
{body}
\n
" def publish_blog_article(subject: str, description: str) -> str: """ Render a user‑submitted blog post safely for display. Parameters ---------- subject : str The title of the blog post. description : str The main body content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized, formatted HTML string ready for safe rendering. """ # Escape any characters that could be interpreted as markup or script safe_title = html.escape(subject, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(description, quote=True) # Insert the sanitized content into the template formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_post
